company.name: Curacel
company.shortDescription: Curacel is an insurtech company that offers an AI-powered platform for claims processing and fraud management.
company.description:
Curacel is an AI-powered platform for claims processing and fraud management.

Curacel automates the insurance claims process, allowing staff to process claims volumes quickly and efficiently, and automatically vets claims to detect fraud, waste and abuse. 

Curacel was established in 2019 by Henry Mascot in Ikoyi, Lagos.
